artifact.candidate_scope: This 42,798-byte rank-only build is the exact artifact the user manually hosted on Dropbox and registered as registration 41 after registration 19 lost one factual paraphrase-ordering pair. Independent postflight download reproduced its byte size, SHA-256, and raw-byte Keccak-256. It passes the published ABI, the existing weather corpus, and 87 synthetic factual pairs with a minimum margin of 0.206250. Its 0.959623 synthetic ordinal Spearman measures exact > good > bad ordering on handcrafted cases and is not comparable to Telegraph's live candidate-versus-champion historical-score correlation. Registration 41 reached champion comparison, establishing Stage 1 passage, and failed Stage 2 at 31 of 32 candidate ordering wins versus the champion's 32 of 32. Its candidate margin was 0.37852418 versus the champion's 0.37360683, but the reported promotion rule is per-case ordering wins rather than direct aggregate-margin comparison. The previously registered 16,292-byte artifact remains retained under registered_artifact and produced registration 19's separate 31-of-32 Stage 2 result. No further registration is authorized.
